sections.label: National Jobs Council spearheads SGUnited
sections.summary: The National Jobs Council will lead a Whole-of-Government effort to bring together 100,000 jobs and skills opportunities through the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The National Jobs Council will spearhead the Whole-of-Government effort to bring together 100,000 jobs and skills opportunities through the SGUnited Jobs and Skills Package.

sections.label: Foreign workforce policy adjustments
sections.summary: Due to COVID-19 and economic disruption, foreign workforce policies will be adjusted, including raising salary criteria for EP and S Passes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: However, with COVID-19 and the economic disruption it has caused, there is now more slack in the labour market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will therefore make further adjustments to our foreign workforce policies, including raising the salary criteria for EP and S Passes, to reflect the changed conditions.

sections.label: Progressive Wage Model income increases
sections.summary: In cleaning, security, and landscaping where PWM is fully implemented, full-time workers' gross monthly incomes rose about 30% in five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In sectors like cleaning, security, and landscaping where the Progressive Wage Model (PWM) has been fully implemented, full-time workers have seen their gross monthly incomes increase by around 30% in the last five years, much higher than median wages.

sections.label: Expanding Progressive Wage Model sectors
sections.summary: Over time, the PWM will be expanded to more sectors practically while preserving low local unemployment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Over time, we will expand the PWM to more sectors, in a manner that is practical and ensures we preserve low levels of local unemployment.

sections.label: Workfare, Silver Support, disability employment support
sections.summary: Workfare payouts rose from January 2020; enhanced Silver Support helps 100,000 more seniors; the EEC covers about four in five PwD employees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Workfare payouts were raised from January 2020 to uplift more workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The enhanced Silver Support will provide higher payouts and help 100,000 more seniors with lesser means, covering up to one in three of our elderly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To better support persons with disabilities (PwDs), we introduced the Enabling Employment Credit (EEC) which will cover about four in five of current PwD employees.

sections.label: Assurance, Care & Engagement Group
sections.summary: A new operating unit, the Assurance, Care & Engagement (ACE) Group, will take over and continue the Inter-Agency Task Force's work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We will also build on the experience of managing and safeguarding the wellbeing of migrant workers during the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We have set up a new operating unit – the Assurance, Care & Engagement (ACE) Group – to take over and continue the work of the Inter-Agency Task Force.
